description:
Activate Black Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any one color.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Black Lotus from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Hardened Academic triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Cast Black Lotus from the top of your library by paying 0 life through Bolas's Citadel.
Repeat.
